newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Persetel says to stay on acquisition track.
newsitem.headline: Persetel says to stay on acquisition track.

text.p: Persetel Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it planned to keep buying other companies in pursuit of earnings outside of South Africa, adding that this high level of investment could impact short-term earnings growth.
"In the short term additional significant investments are being planned...This may have a moderate effect on the short term earnings growth," the company said in a statement with its 1997 results.
However, the group said it "remains confident that it will continue to meet or exceed its medium term targets."
Persetel said that it was now earning around 60 percent of profits outside South Africa and would continue to search for opportunities to strengthen its overseas position.

"Persetel Holdings is expected to continue on its acquisition path to achieve the group objective of expanding further into the global information technology market," it said after posting a 52 percent rise in 1996/97 earnings per share to 70.1 cents.
